NGA.note: Mentions FIRS's digital transformation agenda only; no national digital strategy is stated.
TaxPro Max is called locally developed but no government staff or body is stated to build or run it.

facts.fact: FIRS states all tax and levy collections must be processed through assessments raised on the TaxPro Max platform, which handles payment processing and receipts.
The article states TaxPro Max, the FIRS digital tax administration platform, enables taxpayer registration and filing of returns in a fully automated environment.
FIRS directed that all tax payments must originate from assessments on TaxPro Max, which the article says handles payment processing.
The article states TaxPro Max, the exclusive channel for taxpayer transactions with FIRS, enables taxpayer registration.
